write_mmcif_from_filepath_and_id: write an input mmCIF file to an output mmCIF filepath using sampled coordinates
write_mmcif: write a BioPython Structure object to an mmCIF file via an intermediate Biomolecule object
write_mmcif_sampled_coords: write mmCIF output with sampled atom positions and B-factors replacing original coordinates
write_mmcif_gapless_seq: write mmCIF with gapless poly-sequence and original atom names preserved
write_mmcif_no_metadata: write mmCIF without alphafold metadata and without inserting original atom names
